bench.name: exact_die_bench
bench.cmd: python3 tools/hbm_idx_die_bench.py prepare --work {RUN}/vec && bash physical/hbm_accel_die_views/index/run_bench.sh {SRC} {RUN}/vec {RUN}/bench 24 1 && for c in base MUT_LANE MUT_GID MUT_KEEP MUT_SVAL MUT_QORD; do python3 tools/hbm_idx_die_bench.py compare --work {RUN}/vec --run {RUN}/bench/$c > {RUN}/bench/$c/cmp.txt; echo $c $?; done | tee {RUN}/bench/summary.txt; awk '$1=="base"&&$2!=0{f=1} $1!="base"&&$2==0{f=1} END{exit f}' {RUN}/bench/summary.txt
